extraction.Name: Katherine Andrews
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, but accepted it under protest for the reason that she was told that if she did not take it and pay the taxes that the land would be sold to satisfy them
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: has not sold or mortgaged any of her allotment
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in fair health; has a sister depending on her for support; has received no aid from the Government, County or State since patent in fee was issued; document sworn June 28, 1929; county is Shannon (South Dakota); signed with mark (llucoe Lllnetuo appears to be a signature mark)
